name: Rue des Gestes — étape 5 · fermer, casser, mettre
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (farmer closing the gate on three geese, cook whose casserole dish breaks on the cobbles, kangaroo rolling a beach ball on the balcony, man catching a butterfly at the upper window, stork setting a parcel down on the roof terrace), -ir/-re RIGHT (tailor putting on his top hat, tape measure round his neck). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
